x-intellij-html-description:
title: Holder Condition (Item Condition Type) date: 2024-12-20

Holder Condition

Item Condition Types

Checks whether the entity holding this item stack meets a given Entity Condition. If the item stack has no holder, the condition returns false.

Type ID: sync:holder_condition

Fields

Field Type Default Description
condition Entity Condition optional The condition to test on the holder. If omitted, the condition simply returns true when a holder exists.

How It Works

  • The item stack must be linked to a holder (as described in Holder Action Item Action).
  • If condition is provided, it is evaluated on the holder entity; the overall condition succeeds if the holder exists and the condition passes.
  • If condition is omitted, the condition succeeds if the stack has any holder at all.

Examples

{
  "type": "sync:holder_condition",
  "condition": {
    "type": "apoli:entity_type",
    "entity_type": "minecraft:player"
  }
}

Check if the holder is a player.

{
  "type": "sync:holder_condition",
  "condition": {
    "type": "apoli:sneaking"
  }
}

Check if the holder is sneaking.

{
  "type": "sync:holder_condition"
}

Check if the stack is being held at all.
